editionData.description: Global headlines: In summit with Trump and Putin, Xi put himself and China at center stage (Chinese leader Xi Jinping played the role of choreographer and convener at this week’s APEC summit, showcasing his country as stable and indispensable); Uncontacted Indigenous people emerge from Amazon forest to ask for food (Their appearance startled onlookers and worried anthropologists as threats to their territory multiply); and Iran war has worsened U.S. munitions shortage, government watchdog finds (A Government Accountability Office report contradicts assertions made by President Donald Trump and other administration officials who have rejected stockpile concerns). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: OpenSSL: Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() (CVE-2026-121481, CVSS 9.8) (This fixes "Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock()" (CVE-2026-121481) by returning -1 for invalid inputs to EVP_EncodeBlock(): NULL input or...); Jujutsu Primer (A short tour through the basics of the Jujutsu version control system); and FFmpeg 9.1 'Gauss' (FFmpeg only provides source code. Below are some links that provide it already compiled and ready to go).
